title: On a phone the + and the remove x work without hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A.
  • Open the work order on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
custom_steps:
1. Tap the card's edit button to expand it.
  2. Tap the + button.
  3. Tap "Sales Representative - Parts".
  4. Tap the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card expands.
  • The + button shows beside the Sales Representative field at its full size, without any hover.

Step 2:

  • A menu opens.

Step 3:

  • "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" show, both reading sales rep A.
  • Each shows its arrow.
  • The remove x shows beside Parts.

Step 4:

  • One "Sales Representative" field shows again, reading sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
  • S2-R6: “Both fields start with the person who was in the one field, or "Unassigned" if it was empty. Adding the Parts field on its own changes nobody's credit.”
  • S2-R16: “Clicking the remove x replaces the two fields with the one "Sales Representative" field. It holds the person who was in "Sales Representative - Labor", or "Unassigned", and that person is credited with the whole work order, labor and parts.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
